title: Fourier expansion on its support
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $p$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $x$ be a point of that cube. The sum, over all coordinate sets with nonzero Fourier coefficient for $p$, of the Fourier coefficient times the corresponding sign monomial evaluated at $x$ equals $p(x)$.
hypotheses_covered: real-valued function $p$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
